name: ralph-codex
description: Skills, prompts, and workspace helpers for the Ralph autonomous Codex CLI task loop.

interface.shortDescription: Run PRD stories through a long-running Codex CLI loop
interface.longDescription: Ralph Codex is a Codex-first fork of Ralph that converts PRDs into small JSON stories and runs fresh Codex CLI iterations until every story is complete, preserving memory through git history, progress.txt, prd.json, and AGENTS.md.
defaultPrompt: Create a PRD for this feature
Convert this PRD to Ralph prd.json
